title: Random-example work exponent
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $Q$, the random-example work exponent is the maximum of the singleton sample exponent at $(C,Q)$ plus two and the sum of the family exponent, second-stage sample exponent, and one at $(C,Q)$.
